tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Plans, prices (USD and INR) and what each one includes.

tools.name: start_free_test
tools.description: Ask for a free test of a website. Emails the user a confirmation link; the test runs only after they click it, and the result is emailed to them. Pass only the website and the email the user gave you.

tools.name: get_free_test_status
tools.description: Status of a free test request, by the request_id it returned.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: A checkout link with the plan (starter or agents), site and email filled in; billing is month (default) or year. Every plan is a subscription that renews until the user cancels. Charges nothing: hand the link to the user, who checks it and pays on the payment page. The agents plan needs the site own

tools.name: get_audit_status
tools.description: Status of a paid audit. key is the report key (from the report link) or the order id from the payment page; without it you get an error.
